name: Spotsnow
description: Podcast advertising and market intelligence for shows, networks, agencies and brands. Research any podcast, its hosts, categories, ad history, and current advertisers, or any brand, its spend, growth, industry context, and where it places ads. Built for advertisers finding the right shows to buy and networks and creators finding the right brands to pitch.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Spotsnow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Spotsnow to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://backend.spotsnow.io/mcp-pro. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Spotsnow MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spotsnow lists 16 MCP tools, including discover_ad_inventories, find_podcasts_by_audience_description, generate_campaign, get_batch_lookalike_shows, get_brand_details, get_brand_sponsored_shows, get_bulk_podcasts_fill_rate, get_industry_details, get_network_podcasts, get_network_prospect_brands, get_new_performing_podcasts, and get_podcast_advertising_brands.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Spotsnow?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Spotsnow in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Spotsnow requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Spotsnow is developed by spotsnow. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
